```{r}
res_df <- res_micro %>%
  mutate(
    padj = as.numeric(padj),
    log2FoldChange_shrunk = as.numeric(log2FoldChange_shrunk),
    logP = -log10(pmax(padj, .Machine$double.xmin)),  # avoid Inf
    significance = dplyr::case_when(
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange_shrunk >  1 ~ "Up in Cave",
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange_shrunk < -1 ~ "Up in Surface",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  )

ggplot(res_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = logP, color = significance)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Up in Cave" = "palevioletred",
    "Up in Surface" = "darkseagreen3",
    "Not significant" = "lightgray"
  )) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  labs(
    title = "Volcano Plot: Cave vs Surface (Microglia)",
    x = "Shrunken log2 Fold Change (Cave vs Surface)",
    y = "-log10 Adjusted p-value",
    color = "DE Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

### functional deg labels
```{r}
## ============================================================
## Microglia wave I: Pseudobulk vs FindMarkers
## 3 separate plots:
##   (1) Venn overlap (non-LOC)
##   (2) Pseudobulk dotplot (shared genes marked)
##   (3) FindMarkers-only dotplot (MAST-only; non-shared)
##
## Requires objects:
##   pseudo_res        # DESeq2 results table
##   myelMast.de.ann   # FindMarkers table
## ============================================================

stopifnot(exists("pseudo_res"), exists("myelMast.de.ann"))

## ---------------------------
## Helpers
## ---------------------------
is_loc <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  is.na(x) | x == "" | str_detect(x, regex("^LOC\\d+", ignore_case = TRUE))
}

assert_all_mapped <- function(df, map_df, gene_col = "gene_label", name = "data") {
  if (!gene_col %in% names(df)) {
    stop(sprintf("'%s' column not found in %s. Columns: %s",
                 gene_col, name, paste(names(df), collapse = ", ")), call. = FALSE)
  }
  genes <- unique(as.character(df[[gene_col]]))
  genes <- genes[!is.na(genes) & genes != ""]
  missing <- setdiff(genes, unique(as.character(map_df$gene_label)))
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    stop(
      sprintf(
        "Functional map incomplete for %s.\nAdd FunctionalGroup labels for:\n%s",
        name, paste(missing, collapse = ", ")
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

make_dotplot <- function(df, title, group_cols, show_shared_strip = FALSE) {

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      FunctionalGroup = factor(FunctionalGroup, levels = names(group_cols)),
      abs_lfc = abs(lfc),
      neglog10padj = -log10(pmax(padj, .Machine$double.xmin))
    ) %>%
    arrange(Group, FunctionalGroup, desc(abs_lfc), padj) %>%
    mutate(gene_label = factor(gene_label, levels = rev(unique(gene_label))))

  dot_main <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Group, y = gene_label)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = neglog10padj, colour = abs_lfc), alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_colour_viridis_c(
    name   = "|log2FC|",
    option = "viridis",
    limits = c(0, 8),
    oob    = scales::squish
  ) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = expression(-log[10](padj))) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )

  group_strip <- ggplot(df, aes(x = 1, y = gene_label, fill = FunctionalGroup)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_cols, drop = FALSE) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    xlim(0.5, 1.5)

  if (show_shared_strip) {
    shared_strip <- ggplot(df, aes(x = 1, y = gene_label, fill = Shared)) +
      geom_tile() +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("Shared" = "black", "Pseudo-only" = "grey90"), drop = FALSE) +
      theme_void() +
      theme(legend.position = "none") +
      xlim(0.5, 1.5)

    dot_main + shared_strip + group_strip +
      plot_layout(widths = c(4, 0.35, 1.0), guides = "collect") &
      theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  } else {
    dot_main + group_strip +
      plot_layout(widths = c(4, 1.0), guides = "collect") &
      theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  }
}

## ---------------------------
## Standardize inputs + remove LOC genes
## ---------------------------
pseudo <- pseudo_res %>%
  mutate(
    gene_label = as.character(final_gene_symbol),
    lfc = as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(log2FoldChange_shrunk), log2FoldChange_shrunk, log2FoldChange)),
    padj = as.numeric(padj),
    Group = ifelse(lfc > 0, "Cave", "Surface"),
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Cave", "Surface"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is_loc(gene_label)) %>%
  mutate(gene_label = str_trim(gene_label)) %>%
  distinct(gene_label, .keep_all = TRUE)

mast <- myelMast.de.ann %>%
  mutate(
    gene_label = coalesce(as.character(final_gene_symbol), as.character(gene)),
    lfc = as.numeric(avg_log2FC),
    padj = as.numeric(p_val_adj),
    Group = case_when(
      str_detect(significance, regex("cave", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Cave",
      str_detect(significance, regex("surface", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Surface",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Cave", "Surface"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
  filter(!is_loc(gene_label)) %>%
  mutate(gene_label = str_trim(gene_label)) %>%
  distinct(gene_label, Group, .keep_all = TRUE)

## Direction-aware shared genes (same sign direction)
overlap_all <- union(
  intersect(pseudo$gene_label[pseudo$Group == "Cave"],    mast$gene_label[mast$Group == "Cave"]),
  intersect(pseudo$gene_label[pseudo$Group == "Surface"], mast$gene_label[mast$Group == "Surface"])
)

## ---------------------------
## Plot 1 — Venn overlap (non-LOC)
## ---------------------------
venn_fit <- euler(list(
  Pseudobulk  = unique(pseudo$gene_label),
  FindMarkers = unique(mast$gene_label)
))

# have to manually save because not ggplot
pdf("Microglia_overlap_venn_nonLOC.pdf", width = 6.5, height = 5.5)

plot(venn_fit, quantities = TRUE, labels = TRUE,
     main = "Overlap of significant DE genes (non-LOC): Pseudobulk vs FindMarkers")

dev.off()



## ---------------------------
## Functional map 
## ---------------------------
func_map <- tribble(
  ~gene_label,  ~FunctionalGroup,

  ## Guidance / developmental patterning / receptor cues
  "wnt5b",      "Guidance & patterning",
  "plxnb2a.1",  "Guidance & patterning",
  "adgrb2",     "Guidance & patterning",
  "alk",        "Guidance & patterning",
  "ptprd",      "Guidance & patterning",

  ## ECM / boundary / interface
  "col4a3",     "ECM & boundary",
  "itgb7",      "Adhesion & interface",
  "cldni",      "Adhesion & interface",
  "mdga2a",     "Adhesion & interface",
  "pcdh15a",    "Adhesion & interface",
  "zgc:162952", "Adhesion & interface",

  ## Cytoskeleton / morphology / motility-associated scaffolds
  "kaznb",      "Cytoskeleton & morphology",
  "strip2",     "Cytoskeleton & morphology",
  "sipa1l3",    "Cytoskeleton & morphology",
  "ank3b",      "Cytoskeleton & morphology",

  ## Immune tone / sensing
  "nlrc5l",     "Immune tone",
  "btnl2",      "Immune tone",
  "trim16l",    "Immune tone",
  "grk6",       "Immune tone",

  ## Signaling / homeostasis / proteostasis / stress
  "pde4ba",     "Signaling tone (cAMP/GPCR)",
  "wnk3",       "Ion/volume homeostasis",
  "rnft1",      "Proteostasis (ubiquitin)",
  "trim33l",    "Proteostasis (ubiquitin)",
  "rnh1",       "Stress/RNA handling",

  ## Immediate early (if present)
  "fosl2",      "Immediate-early / AP-1",

  ## Developmental pruning / uptake signature
  "stxbp5a",    "Synaptic material engulfment",
  "basp1",      "Synaptic material engulfment",
  "dip2ca",     "Synaptic material engulfment",
  "dip2ba",     "Synaptic material engulfment",
  "dlgap3",     "Synaptic material engulfment",
  "hcn1",       "Synaptic material engulfment",

  ## Retroelement
  "zferv1",     "Endogenous retroviral activation"
)

group_cols <- c(
  "Guidance & patterning"             = "#6366f1",
  "ECM & boundary"                    = "#fb7185",
  "Adhesion & interface"              = "#0ea5e9",
  "Cytoskeleton & morphology"         = "#f59e0b",
  "Immune tone"                       = "#22c55e",
  "Signaling tone (cAMP/GPCR)"        = "#7c3aed",
  "Ion/volume homeostasis"            = "#14b8a6",
  "Proteostasis (ubiquitin)"          = "#eab308",
  "Stress/RNA handling"               = "#f97316",
  "Immediate-early / AP-1"            = "#db2777",
  "Synaptic material engulfment"      = "#94a3b8",
  "Endogenous retroviral activation"  = "#ef4444"
)

## Hard-stop if any plotted gene isn't mapped
assert_all_mapped(pseudo, func_map, name = "Pseudobulk plotted genes")
assert_all_mapped(mast,   func_map, name = "FindMarkers plotted genes")

## ---------------------------
## Plot 2 — Pseudobulk (shared genes marked)
## ---------------------------
pseudo_plot <- pseudo %>%
  left_join(func_map, by = "gene_label") %>%
  mutate(Shared = ifelse(gene_label %in% overlap_all, "Shared", "Pseudo-only"))

p_pseudo <- make_dotplot(

p_pseudo
```
